items.title: Hold an Allentown business license
items.authority: City of Allentown Bureau of Revenue and Audit
items.description: Anyone conducting business in Allentown needs a city business license, valid for the calendar year.

items.title: File Allentown business privilege tax
items.authority: City of Allentown Bureau of Revenue and Audit
items.description: The business privilege tax is an annual tax on gross receipts for the privilege of conducting business in the city, under the city's regulations and Chapter 570.

items.title: Obtain Philadelphia Commercial Activity License
items.description: Free license required for any business operating in Philadelphia; required before other city licenses.

items.title: File Philadelphia Business Income & Receipts Tax (BIRT)
items.description: Annual tax on gross receipts and net income for entities doing business in Philadelphia.

items.title: Withhold and remit Philadelphia Wage Tax
items.description: Employers withhold the city wage tax from employees and remit it with the quarterly reconciliation.

items.title: Register for Pittsburgh payroll expense tax and local services tax
items.authority: City of Pittsburgh Department of Finance
items.description: Employers with employees working in Pittsburgh register for the payroll expense tax and withhold the local services tax per employee.
